confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful unauthorized login, followed by privilege escalation, bulk data exfiltration, and anti-forensic activity (log deletion) by user_04. Additionally, user_08 exhibits a pattern of suspicious cross-departmental data access.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt: multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (185.220.101.45) against user_04.
Successful unauthorized login for user_04 from the suspicious IP.
Privilege escalation: user_04 successfully elevated their role.
Bulk data exfiltration: user_04 downloaded 12 sensitive files from the finance directory in rapid succession.
Anti-forensics: user_04 deleted authentication logs to hide traces of the intrusion.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_04's credentials were stolen via phishing or if the account was compromised via brute force.
Verification of whether user_08's cross-departmental access was part of a separate insider threat or a secondary compromise.
narrative: An attacker successfully performed a brute-force attack on user_04, gained access from an external IP, escalated privileges, and exfiltrated multiple finance files before deleting authentication logs. Simultaneously, user_08 engaged in highly suspicious cross-departmental data downloading, suggesting either a second compromised account or an insider threat.
